attributes.residual: EXACTLY ONE PROOF STEP IS MISSING, and it is named. The residual decomposes into two parts, both understood. (1) TWO COPY-VERSUS-CONSTANT WORDS, +0xe4 and +0x174, structurally identical because the block is duplicated: target `li r27,0` against ours `addi r26,r25,0`, with our r25 holding 0 from an immediately preceding `li r25,0` that is BYTE-IDENTICAL in both streams. These are served today by equivalent_copy_form's `constant_dataflow_inverse_recolor`, which re-encodes our word to `li r26,0` and leaves the r26-vs-r27 difference for the recolor. (2) SIX USES where our r25 must correspond to the target's r27 (or our r26 to the target's r25). Both registers provably hold literal 0, but they were loaded by INDEPENDENT `li` instructions, and verify_value_equality_recolor's relation is seeded with the identity and then closed only over VALUE-PRESERVING COPIES (_value_preserving_copy accepts `mr`/`addi rD,rS,0`/`fmr` and rejects `li` by construction). Two independent constant loads of the same literal are therefore never related, however obviously equal, and the six uses are refused. With a per-stream constant map added alongside the relation the function is BYTE-EQUAL to the target. That is a class widening, so it is proposed to the integrator as claim.WR_constant-equality-closure-class-proposal.20260903.v1 and NOT shipped here; the run-42 postprocessor order was 'existing classes ONLY'.
